name: EPIC 211406013
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 7.0 solar radii and 1.03 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211406013 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.953796 (16th-84th percentiles 6.714767-7.201186), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,089 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.03 solar masses and 7.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,853 K at its surface.
